structure.unit: Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services

law.catch_line: Data reporting on children and adolescents

text.section:
The Department shall collect and compile the following data:
The total number of licensed mental health inpatient psychiatric beds for children and adolescents; and
The total number of licensed psychiatric residential treatment facility beds for children and adolescents.

The Department shall report this data on a quarterly basis to the Chairmen of the House Committee on Appropriations and the Senate Committee on Finance and Appropriations and to the Virginia Commission on Youth.
